feedback-haptic.$description: When a Beatham product plays a haptic. Never the only feedback: each also has a visual change.

snap.$description: Something snaps into place (a point to a guide, a slider to a detent).

confirm.$description: An action is applied (a value set, a command sent).

reached.$description: A soft threshold is reached (a target value, a step in a sequence).

warning.$description: Something is about to go wrong.
